source_caption:
🎬 Soul on Fire (2025)

Soul on Fire tells the powerful and inspiring true story of John O’Leary, a young boy whose life changes forever after a devastating accident leaves him with severe burns across most of his body. At just nine years old, John faces unimaginable pain and a difficult fight for survival, with doctors uncertain whether he will recover. Supported by his loving family, dedicated medical professionals, and an extraordinary community of people who refuse to give up on him, John begins a remarkable journey of healing, courage, and hope. As he grows older, the challenges of his childhood continue to shape his understanding of life, inspiring him to embrace gratitude, overcome fear, and discover a greater purpose. Starring Joel Courtney, John Corbett, Stephanie Szostak, and William H. Macy, the film delivers an emotional and uplifting story about faith, family, resilience, second chances, and the incredible power of kindness to transform someone’s life.

🎭 Genre: Biography • Drama • Faith • Inspirational

⏱️ Runtime: Approximately 1h 52m • PG

🎥 Director: Sean McNamara

✍️ Writer: Gregory Poirier

📚 Based On: The true story of motivational speaker and author John O’Leary, inspired by his memoir On Fire: The 7 Choices to Ignite a Radically Inspired Life.

❤️ Themes: Faith, family, courage, perseverance, gratitude, and overcoming life’s greatest challenges.

📺 Where to Watch: Check Amazon Prime Video and Apple TV for current streaming, rental, or purchase availability in the United States.

source_details.synopsis: Soul on Fire is a 2025 American biographical drama film about John O'Leary, a real-life St. Louis native who survived fire burns which covered his entire body. It is directed by Sean McNamara, based on a screenplay by Gregory Poirier that adapted O'Leary's book On Fire, The 7 Choices to Ignite a Radically Inspired Life. The film stars Joel Courtney portraying O'Leary, along with John Corbett, Stéphanie Szostak, Masey McLain, DeVon Franklin, and William H. Macy. It was released in the United States and Canada on October 10, 2025 by Sony Pictures Releasing.
